text_block_list.text:
"Heading to the track to conduct Neo 
Universe's training—"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Then let us move on to the next phase! 
Universe-kun, start measuring the 
brainwaves!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well! Come now, calm down. I 
merely wish to know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you ever felt it? The presence of 
"something" supernatural underlying 
Universe's every word and deed...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They're coming up with crazy hypotheses 
like, “She's communicating with somethin' 
through a sixth sense.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is a matter of paramount importance 
regarding the mysteries of the Umamusume, 
you know~? Didn't you promise you'd help 
me out?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't expect you to make me do 
something that felt like a damn 
experiment! Dammit."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Universe. You don't gotta keep this 
guy company, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Those two are "INTI" beings. 
Maybe we'll discover Neo Universe's true 
identity.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Universe, you and I see eye to 
eye! Come now, let us keep up this 
momentum!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
First, let us search for the trigger for 
"contact"! The key is stimulation—stimuli 
upon stimuli...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now, how does my special instant electric 
bath feel!?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Bzzzzzz...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... More importantly, I'm 
"looking forward" to the "analysis."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
How is it? Feeling the effects of the 
medicine? Relaxing and entering a state of 
absolute tranquility...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
These brainwaves... are from normal sleep. 
It's REM sleep.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! You sure know how to tease. Guess the 
"descent" isn't happening anytime soon!
choice_data_list:
Well then, let's wrap it up around here 
for today...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ……“ASEM”。

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What did you just say?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphira... "CUTT" is filled with 
"transmission" that bridges the 
"severance"...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!? Ahahaha! It's here! Everyone, our 
guest of honor has finally arrived!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the electrodes! Now's my only 
chance to intervene in the dream!!

"The experiments are getting too 
extreme...! I can't let this go any 
further—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. It's "alright."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...I heard the sound of anxiety. However, 
Neo Universe is 'game'.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Even if they take an interest in the 
'Unknown,' those who actually take 
'flight' are... 'rare.'

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
So, Neo Universe is 『glad』. Even if it's 
not "METI," Agnes Tachyon and the others 
are 『joy』.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Via Neo Universe's 'brain waves'— 
Interaction is 'delightful.' Talking is 
also 'fun.'"
choice_data_list:
So, as long as you're having fun too, it's 
fine...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, hey! Those brainwaves just now looked 
totally abnormal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, could this be...! You're just 
outputting your brainwaves at will to play 
around!?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. "Ding-dong, correct!"

...It seems there was no need to worry at 
all. In fact, she even had the composure 
to enjoy this exchange as something 
intellectual...
choice_data_list:
Still, keep the experiments in 
moderation...
I'm glad to see you have a close friend!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"ATCP"—It's all right. Agnes Tachyon will 
not take things too far.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Does this guy have zero sense of danger or 
what...?

That was true, but... seeing that she had 
friends around to stop her brought a 
slight sense of relief.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, you're 'blushing', aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, these brainwaves are... Are you happy 
with it? I'm honored!

Even if it's unknown, and even if she 
doesn't know herself. She secretly hoped 
that interacting with peers of her age 
might help her discover something.
